author: cairn
blurb: Live cryptocurrency prices and market data from CoinGecko. No API key needed.

definition.name: CoinGecko
definition.description: Get cryptocurrency prices, market data, and trending coins from the CoinGecko public API.

operations.name: get_coin_price
operations.description: Get the current price of one or more coins in a target currency.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_coin_price","description":"Current crypto prices by CoinGecko coin id.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"ids":{"type":"string","description":"Comma-separated coin ids, e.g. 'bitcoin,ethereum'"},"vs_currencies":{"type":"string","description":"Comma-separated target currencies, e.g. 'usd,eur'"}},"required":["ids","vs_currencies"]}}

operations.name: search_coins
operations.description: Search for coins, exchanges, and categories by name to find their ids.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_coins","description":"Search CoinGecko for a coin id by name.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Coin name or symbol, e.g. 'solana'"}},"required":["query"]}}

operations.name: get_trending_coins
operations.description: Get the top trending coins on CoinGecko in the last 24 hours.
